headline: A new version of Wyrm
author: OM Rajput
releaseNotes: Image arrows from Wyrm iOS, with a picker and live preview.
Seamless Liquid Glass tab bar fold.
Update now button, and Back up before updating is now a switch.
Team mode redesigned like Wyrm iOS: saved teams behind the gear, FPS, ping and leaderboard in the roster, cleaner names and chat.
Slider and switch labels are no longer cut off; pages no longer tuck under the header.
Lobby: Home replaces Quick settings. Colour wheel knob turns only when held.
